title: Oregano-Infused Croatian Cheese Flatbread
description: A steaming, gooey flatbread packed with fragrant oregano and melted cheese, finished in a tandoori oven for a slightly charred crust-perfect for a light lunch or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, yeast, and salt.
Heat the water to about 30–40 °C, stir in the olive oil, and pour the liquid into the dry mixture.
Knead the dough for 5–7 minutes until smooth, then form a ball and let it rise in a lightly oiled bowl, covered, for about 1 hour until doubled in size.
Preheat a tandoor, baking stone, or conventional oven to 220 °C (428 °F).
After the dough has risen, roll it out on parchment parchment paper to a thickness of 3–4 mm, forming a circle about 25 cm in diameter.
Evenly distribute the crumbled feta, chopped fresh oregano, dried oregano, smoked paprika, and grated Parmesan over the dough, leaving a small margin around the edges.
Fold the edges slightly to contain the filling, then slide the flatbread onto the preheated surface.
Bake for 8–10 minutes or until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling and slightly charred.
Remove the flatbread, let it rest for 2 minutes, then slice into wedges and serve warm.
